target.title: fix(discord): add timeouts to voice upload requests
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Discord voice-message sends could wait indefinitely when either the upload-URL request or the attachment upload accepted the HTTP connection but never returned a response.

## Why This Change Was Made

Voice messages use two raw guarded HTTP calls outside the normal Discord REST client: requesting the CDN upload URL, then PUTing the OGG payload. This change adds the same bounded request behavior to both guarded calls while preserving existing SSRF policy, Discord error handling, rate-limit parsing, and upload payloads.

## User Impact

A stalled Discord upload endpoint no longer leaves voice-message delivery wedged forever. The send fails boundedly through the existing error path instead of keeping the channel workflow pending.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run extensions/discord/src/voice-message.test.ts` - passed; `Test Files  1 passed (1)`, `Tests  9 passed (9)`.
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check --threads=1 extensions/discord/src/voice-message.ts extensions/discord/src/voice-message.test.ts` - passed.
- `./node_modules/.bin/oxlint --config .oxlintrc.json --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.extensions.json extensions/discord/src/voice-message.ts extensions/discord/src/voice-message.test.ts` - passed; exit 0.
- `git diff --check upstream/main..HEAD` - passed; exit 0.
- Open PR collision check: searched open PR topics and scanned the latest 500 open PR changed-file lists; no open PR touched `extensions/discord/src/voice-message.ts`.

## Real behavior proof

Behavior addressed: Discord voice upload URL POSTs and attachment PUTs now have deadlines when the remote endpoint accepts the request but never sends a response.

Real environment tested: local Linux Node source checkout; real `node:http` loopback server that handles the Discord upload URL route and upload route, with each test case deliberately hanging one step.

Exact command run after this patch: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run extensions/discord/src/voice-message.test.ts`

Evidence after fix: the focused regression drives the exported `sendDiscordVoiceMessage` path. It asserts the hanging route is reached, the response stream closes after timeout, and the guarded fetch call carries `timeoutMs: 120000` for the relevant upload phase.

What was not tested: live Discord traffic; the hang is reproduced with a real local HTTP server, not the real third-party service.
